description: Program execution fails with a null reference; analysis classifies RUN_FAILED and the correct KB article is retrieved.

analyze.root_cause: Null reference in Hppl494p.cs when the customer master record is missing a guard clause before field access.

kb_articles.title: NullReference in generated C# when optional customer master record is absent
kb_articles.content: When the COBOL optional customer master record is absent the generated C# dereferences a null object. Add a null guard clause before accessing fields in Hppl494p.cs.

kb_articles.title: Rounding difference on decimal output columns during compare
kb_articles.content: Banker's rounding in C# differs from COBOL half-up rounding and produces a compare mismatch on decimal amount columns.

kb_query: null reference Hppl494p.cs customer master record missing guard clause
